request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, soft cello, gentle percussion, hopeful and steady mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
If your brother sins against you
Go and confront him privately
Just the two of you alone
If he listens to your voice
You have won your brother back

[Chorus]
Where two or three are gathered
In my name they find me
I am there among them
Truly I tell you

[Verse]
But if he will not listen
Take one or two others
Let the matter be established
By the testimony of witnesses
If he still refuses to hear
Tell it to the church

[Chorus]
Where two or three are gathered
In my name they find me
I am there among them
Truly I tell you

[Bridge]
Whatever you bind on earth
Will be bound in heaven
Whatever you loose on earth
Will be loosed in heaven

[Chorus]
Where two or three are gathered
In my name they find me
I am there among them
Truly I tell you
